summary: George Russell converted pole position into victory at Baku, weathering a late charge from Max Verstappen across two safety car restarts to secure Mercedes' second consecutive win. Russell described the weekend as "the most dominant I've had in my career," a statement that underscored his complete control from qualifying through the race despite the late-race chaos. The victory narrows the championship gap as Russell's team-mate Kimi Antonelli, who crashed in qualifying, surrenders further ground to the title fight.
